title: Climate ledger: the climate numbers the news quotes, recomputed from pinned sources
description:
A public, reproducible verification of the climate numbers that circulate in reporting. Each entry is a claim, its source, the method, the recomputed value, and a verdict dated the day it was checked.

make freeze fetched each source exactly once and pinned the bytes with a SHA-256 and a provenance record; make verify recomputes every value offline from those bytes and exits non-zero if one moves outside its stated tolerance. Tier A entries are computed from machine-readable data; Tier B entries are transcribed from a document with a page reference and a second read, and the difference is shown rather than hidden.

Scope at release: global temperature, fossil and total CO2 emissions, the remaining 1.5 C carbon budget, the warming implied by current policies, adaptation finance, and South Africa's coal share of electricity.
notes: Code is MIT licensed; prose and derived data are CC BY 4.0. Pinned upstream sources keep their own terms, recorded in NOTICE.md. Some sources are cited but deliberately not redistributed.
